title: FBI Photo B16
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a grainy grayscale infrared-style photograph of two unidentified objects, noting that the timestamp on the image is incorrect.

incidents.summary: FBI submitted a still image of two dark, irregular-shaped objects captured by a U.S. military system.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: Two dark, irregular-shaped objects are visible just right of the center
